description: Ordered development captures for PR review and website use.
processing: Lossless PNG encoding only; original pixels and dimensions preserved.

captures.title: Early UEFI battery status
captures.caption: An early firmware-status capture, before the desktop filled in. The 50% reading comes from a synthetic ACPI battery fixture.
captures.alt: Early UEFI battery status in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Wi-Fi controls reach the desktop
captures.caption: The first integrated Wi-Fi Settings pane reports that QEMU has no supported Wi-Fi adapter. This is not a connected physical radio.
captures.alt: Wi-Fi controls reach the desktop in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Native sound output
captures.caption: Settings discovers the emulated AC97 stereo sink and starts at full volume. The native audio tests separately measured recorded PCM.
captures.alt: Native sound output in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Mute reaches the audio sink
captures.caption: Actual pointer input enables mute; the desktop acceptance test checks the corresponding kernel state.
captures.alt: Mute reaches the audio sink in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Volume changes are applied
captures.caption: The output slider reaches 49% through the native audio control path. Microphone capture is still unavailable.
captures.alt: Volume changes are applied in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Display and brightness controls
captures.caption: Settings reports VirtIO display with software rendering. A synthetic ACPI backlight fixture receives the brightness change from 60% to 40%.
captures.alt: Display and brightness controls in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Power and automatic locking
captures.caption: Idle/lid locking and dimming preferences are wired up. Synthetic mixed battery units deliberately produce an unavailable combined percentage; sleep remains unavailable.
captures.alt: Power and automatic locking in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: First account setup
captures.caption: The native GUI test enters a disposable test account and masked password through real keyboard and pointer input.
captures.alt: First account setup in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Password login
captures.caption: Normal boot presents the login screen after account creation instead of development autologin.
captures.alt: Password login in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Lock screen
captures.caption: The authenticated session is hidden behind its unlock greeter after Ctrl+Alt+L.
captures.alt: Lock screen in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Incorrect passwords keep the session locked
captures.caption: The GUI test submits an incorrect password and verifies that the kernel session gate stays locked.
captures.alt: Incorrect passwords keep the session locked in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Files and Terminal together
captures.caption: Both applications run in the authenticated session. Alt+Tab and Alt+Shift+Tab are checked against the compositor focused-window ID.
captures.alt: Files and Terminal together in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Notification center
captures.caption: A native application posts Build / Workspace ready inside the live session. The notification center displays its application source and Clear action.
captures.alt: Notification center in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Files in the live home
captures.caption: Files is launched from the dock with the live session home and its standard folders, including Trash. Copy/move/Trash/Restore behavior has separate native tests.
captures.alt: Files in the live home in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Current Wi-Fi Settings
captures.caption: The current desktop continues to report absent radio hardware accurately. Physical AX200 WPA2/DHCP/DNS acceptance is still outstanding.
captures.alt: Current Wi-Fi Settings in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Logout from the desktop
captures.caption: The GUI regression chooses Log Out while a session child repeatedly writes and synchronizes a 64-KiB file.
captures.alt: Logout from the desktop in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Logout returns to login
captures.caption: The whole former session has stopped, and a cold filesystem integrity check succeeds after the active writer is drained.
captures.alt: Logout returns to login in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Desktop after a new boot
captures.caption: A new VM boot uses the saved account, authenticates successfully and starts with an empty notification history.
captures.alt: Desktop after a new boot in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Verified installation from recovery
captures.caption: The recovery console completes a verified copy from a padded source image to disposable NVMe storage, expands the root and prints device/mount diagnostics.
captures.alt: Verified installation from recovery in EmbLinkOS

captures.title: Installed disk boots alone
captures.caption: The newly installed NVMe target boots without the source disk and presents first-account setup. Both disks are disposable QEMU images.
captures.alt: Installed disk boots alone in EmbLinkOS
